editor.title: Title
editor.info: Status after the title (text or Jinja template)
editor.info_alert: Status in accent color when (YAML: entity, above, below, state)
editor.chips: Values on the right as chips (YAML list: entity, label, unit, decimals, muted, alert, tap_action)
editor.variables: CSS variables (YAML, inherited by the cards in the panel)
editor.min_column_width: Minimum column width (grid only, e.g. 380px – wraps on narrow screens)
editor.frame: Show panel surface (off = layout container only)

editor.name: Name (default: entity name)
editor.since_line: Show the "since …" line below the name
editor.since_attribute: Timestamp attribute instead of the last change (e.g. last_triggered)
editor.detail_entities: Values instead of the "since …" line while on (YAML list: entity, label)
editor.online_entity: Online entity (icon pulses until the device is reachable)
